seo.title: Heart Disease: Symptoms, Causes, Treatment | Doctors Hub
seo.description: Learn about Heart Disease — symptoms, causes, risk factors, diagnosis, treatment options, and prevention tips.

overview: Heart disease encompasses coronary artery disease, heart failure, and arrhythmias — leading causes of death in India. Risk rises with diabetes, hypertension, smoking, and sedentary lifestyle.
symptoms: Chest pain or pressure with exertion (angina)
riskFactors: Family history of premature heart disease
diagnosis: Stress test or coronary angiography when indicated
treatment: Statins, antiplatelets, beta-blockers, ACE inhibitors as indicated
Angioplasty or bypass for significant coronary disease
Device therapy for arrhythmias or heart failure
prevention: Know family history and screen early
complications: Stroke from emboli or shared atherosclerosis

faqs.question: What causes Heart Disease?
faqs.answer: Multiple factors including genetics, lifestyle, and environment contribute.

faqs.question: Is Heart Disease curable?
faqs.answer: Many conditions are manageable with proper treatment. Consult your doctor for prognosis.

emergencySigns: Pain radiating to arm, jaw, or back
